evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets (K8_C0001 through K8_C0008) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: Leading gaps range from 0.061 (K8_C0008) to 0.156 (K8_C0005), all substantially larger than the next eigengaps (0.0002-0.0027), indicating the single-cluster resolution dominates within each candidate.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.
observations.finding: In every set the first eigengap is the largest by roughly one to two orders of magnitude, and no secondary gap approaches it, so the profile is consistent with a single dominant cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.0097-0.0104) across all candidates, indicating comparable internal cohesion in the fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries (e.g., K8_C0004-K8_C0006 at 0.00926, K8_C0002-K8_C0003 at 0.00925) have between-set affinities only slightly below the within-set range, identifying these pairs as relatively weakly separated boundaries for possible pair review; this is not a merge conclusion.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each candidate set.
observations.finding: All eight candidates have non-trivial membership (7-20 patients), so the structural calculations are based on multiple patients per set.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are relatively close. Every candidate screens at candidate_k=1 with a dominant leading eigengap and no comparable secondary gap, so the partition-level screen does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate; this is triage evidence and does not by itself establish that any set should be split or retained. Within-set affinities are uniformly comparable across candidates, and the nearest-pair affinities identify several relatively weakly separated boundaries (notably K8_C0004-K8_C0006 and K8_C0002-K8_C0003) as entry points for pair review, not as merge conclusions. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is present in this result, so the screen does not directly quantify representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry; it only reports internal spectral structure and pairwise affinities.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports are available for this partition, so these structural diagnostics stand alone and cannot be corroborated or contradicted by earlier evidence in this cycle.
limitations: Partition-level screening provides only triage evidence; it does not supply actual feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements, so internal-subdivision interpretation is limited to the absence of a dominant multi-cluster screening signal.
No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is included, so the result does not directly quantify representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry.

Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point only; weak pair separation does not recommend merge, and the absence of subdivision is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.finding: Within the prespecified driver panel, K8_C0002 shows strong VHL depletion (OR 0.019, 95% CI 0.001-0.320; q_driver 2.8e-05, q_global 0.0066) with 0/15 mutated versus 56/88 in rest, and TP53 enrichment (OR 49.6, 95% CI 2.4-1017; q_driver 0.019) with 3/15 versus 0/88; PBRM1 depletion (OR 0.212, 95% CI 0.045-0.997; q_driver 0.164) and KDM5C enrichment (OR 7.08, 95% CI 1.28-39.2; q_driver 0.164) are nominal-only after driver-panel correction. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0002 shows a coherent and interpretable mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by near-absence of VHL mutation (0/15 versus 56/88; q_driver 2.8e-05, q_global 0.0066) together with TP53 enrichment (3/15 versus 0/88; q_driver 0.019). This VHL-depleted, TP53-enriched pattern is a recognizable molecular identity distinct from the rest of the partition. PBRM1 depletion and KDM5C enrichment are directionally notable but do not survive driver-panel correction (q_driver 0.164), and the exploratory non-panel genes do not survive global correction. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that the current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.

The present mutation result is concordant in indicating a distinct molecular identity for K8_C0002, complementing both the modest geometric separation and the RNA program; these evidence types address different questions and none alone determines retention.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the set-versus-rest contrast is not a clean two-group biological comparison.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All eight candidate sets (K8_C0001 through K8_C0008) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen shows no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution; a large leading gap at k=1 describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: Leading gaps range from 0.061 (K8_C0008) to 0.156 (K8_C0005), all substantially larger than the next eigengaps (0.0002-0.0027), indicating the single-cluster resolution dominates within each candidate.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions; the dominant gap's location and magnitude are interpreted together.
observations.finding: In every set the first eigengap is the largest by roughly one to two orders of magnitude, and no secondary gap approaches it, so the profile is consistent with a single dominant cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are tightly clustered (0.0097-0.0104) across all candidates, indicating comparable internal cohesion in the fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries (e.g., K8_C0004-K8_C0006 at 0.00926, K8_C0002-K8_C0003 at 0.00925) have between-set affinities only slightly below the within-set range, identifying these pairs as relatively weakly separated boundaries for possible pair review; this is not a merge conclusion.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each candidate set.
observations.finding: All eight candidates have non-trivial membership (7-20 patients), so the structural calculations are based on multiple patients per set.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are relatively close. Every candidate screens at candidate_k=1 with a dominant leading eigengap and no comparable secondary gap, so the partition-level screen does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any candidate; this is triage evidence and does not by itself establish that any set should be split or retained. Within-set affinities are uniformly comparable across candidates, and the nearest-pair affinities identify several relatively weakly separated boundaries (notably K8_C0004-K8_C0006 and K8_C0002-K8_C0003) as entry points for pair review, not as merge conclusions. No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is present in this result, so the screen does not directly quantify representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry; it only reports internal spectral structure and pairwise affinities.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports are available for this partition, so these structural diagnostics stand alone and cannot be corroborated or contradicted by earlier evidence in this cycle.
limitations: Partition-level screening provides only triage evidence; it does not supply actual feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements, so internal-subdivision interpretation is limited to the absence of a dominant multi-cluster screening signal.
No current-label alignment or boundary-silhouette metric is included, so the result does not directly quantify representation of the current membership or boundary in patient geometry.

Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point only; weak pair separation does not recommend merge, and the absence of subdivision is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0001 shows a coherent and interpretable mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by near-universal PBRM1 mutation (13/13 versus 26/90; OR 65.7, q_driver 1.1e-05, q_global 0.0027) together with VHL enrichment (13/13 versus 43/90; q_driver 0.0014). This PBRM1-high, VHL-high pattern is a recognizable ccRCC molecular identity distinct from the rest of the partition. TSC2 enrichment is directionally notable but does not survive driver-panel correction (q_driver 0.074), and the exploratory non-panel genes do not survive global correction. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that the current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.

The present mutation result is concordant in indicating a distinct molecular identity for K8_C0001, complementing both the weak geometric representation and the RNA program; these evidence types address different questions and none alone determines retention.

observations.meaning: Number of genes in the full nonsynonymous interpretation matrix tested, including observed genes and configured drivers retained even when all patients are wild type.
observations.finding: A large tested-gene family (3,583 genes) underlies the q_global multiplicity control.

observations.meaning: Target-versus-rest mutation enrichment or depletion for prespecified ccRCC driver-panel genes, with BH-FDR within the driver panel (q_driver) and across the full tested-gene family (q_global).
observations.finding: Within the prespecified driver panel, K8_C0002 shows strong VHL depletion (OR 0.019, 95% CI 0.001-0.320; q_driver 2.8e-05, q_global 0.0066) with 0/15 mutated versus 56/88 in rest, and TP53 enrichment (OR 49.6, 95% CI 2.4-1017; q_driver 0.019) with 3/15 versus 0/88; PBRM1 depletion (OR 0.212, 95% CI 0.045-0.997; q_driver 0.164) and KDM5C enrichment (OR 7.08, 95% CI 1.28-39.2; q_driver 0.164) are nominal-only after driver-panel correction. CDKN2A is not estimable because neither group has events.

observations.meaning: Limited display subset of non-driver-panel genes with the largest nominal enrichment; every interpretation-matrix gene participates in q_global.
observations.finding: Several non-driver-panel genes show nominal enrichment (e.g., CHD9, GPR15, GRIN2B, NR2F2, OPTC, RELN, TRPM6, ULK3 at OR 32.8, 2/15 versus 0/88; LYST at OR 7.08, 3/15 versus 3/88), but none survives q_global multiplicity control (all q_global = 1.0), so these are exploratory signals only.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: K8_C0002 shows a coherent and interpretable mutation phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, dominated by near-absence of VHL mutation (0/15 versus 56/88; q_driver 2.8e-05, q_global 0.0066) together with TP53 enrichment (3/15 versus 0/88; q_driver 0.019). This VHL-depleted, TP53-enriched pattern is a recognizable molecular identity distinct from the rest of the partition. PBRM1 depletion and KDM5C enrichment are directionally notable but do not survive driver-panel correction (q_driver 0.164), and the exploratory non-panel genes do not survive global correction. This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that the current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: Prior cross-modal reports for K8_C0002 found a modest but directionally consistent geometric distinction of the current membership (positive silhouettes in all modalities, largest in WXS 0.178 and WSI 0.124, smallest in RNA 0.022), and a prior RNA pathway report found a coherent molecular phenotype (strong down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with up-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid metabolism). The present mutation result is concordant in indicating a distinct molecular identity for K8_C0002, complementing both the modest geometric separation and the RNA program; these evidence types address different questions and none alone determines retention.
limitations: The rest group combines the other seven candidate sets and may be heterogeneous, so the set-versus-rest contrast is not a clean two-group biological comparison.
Driver-panel genes are a post-hoc prespecified ccRCC annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion; q_driver and q_global are distinct multiplicity families and should not be conflated.
Several driver-panel effects (PBRM1, KDM5C) are nominal-only after driver-panel correction, and exploratory non-panel genes do not survive global correction.
Zero-cell Haldane-Anscombe correction inflates odds-ratio magnitude and widens intervals for sparse genes (e.g., TP53, VHL), so effect sizes for rare events are imprecise.
Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

observations.meaning: Genes contributing most to the enrichment of the named pathway; overlap across pathways can indicate shared programs.

actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic programs, and a PBRM1-high/VHL-high mutation pattern), but the evidence that directly bears on its current membership does not support independent retention: current-label alignment shows essentially no separation of the current membership from the rest in any native modality geometry (silhouettes near zero in CT and RNA, negative in WSI and WXS, with within-set and between-set distances nearly equal or reversed). No structural revision is warranted, and independent membership remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.

K8_C0002 has a coherent biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with up-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid metabolism; VHL-depleted, TP53-enriched mutation pattern) and positive evidence bearing on its current membership: current-label alignment shows a modest but directionally consistent separation of the current membership from the rest in all four modalities (positive silhouettes, within-set distance smaller than between-set). The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0002-K8_C0003 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry (boundary silhouette near zero) with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; the set-level membership representation for K8_C0002 remains positive, so the unit is retained.

The pair-level boundary report for K8_C0002-K8_C0003 shows the current pair labels are essentially unseparated in fused geometry with a single-cluster-dominated union, which does not justify merging the two units; independent membership for K8_C0003 remains unsupported, so the unit is not retained.
